title: Mole Antonelliana
visualBrief: Turin’s immense pavilion cupola with parallel granite ribs and roof lights, lower colonnade and temple portico, measured double-order tempietto, concentric circular galleries, tapering octagonal spire and the present star.

nativeAxes.front: −Z is the projecting entrance portico / Via Montebello side; +Z has the broad rear wings
nativeAxes.origin: OSM footprint rectangle center at nominal exterior ground; main cupola centered on the tower axis

scaleBasis: City present height; museum terrace and cupola route; 1890 contemporary engineering dimensions and plate constrain the upper architecture. The former terminal statue is replaced with the modern star visible in museum photographs. OSM controls the asymmetric lower plan.

geographicProposal.evidence: Exact-QID outline places its approximately 29 m projecting entrance portico on local −Z and the broad 50 m rear wings on +Z. The authored plan preserves that asymmetry, resolving the minimum-rectangle half-turn ambiguity.
geographicProposal.limitations: The roughly 29 m mapped portico and broad rear wings agree with the authored footprint. Exact paving joints and the sloping street edge are not modeled.
geographicProposal.notes: Exact-QID outline places its approximately 29 m projecting entrance portico on local −Z and the broad 50 m rear wings on +Z. The authored plan preserves that asymmetry, resolving the minimum-rectangle half-turn ambiguity. The roughly 29 m mapped portico and broad rear wings agree with the authored footprint. Exact paving joints and the sloping street edge are not modeled.

geometrySource: Original deterministic geometry informed by cited dimensions, measured plans and photographs. No downloaded mesh or photographic texture is embedded.
sourceLicense: Original geometry under repository license. Map-derived outline information is attributed to OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL-1.0. Reference publications retain their own rights.
materialMethod: Shared material graphs with metric repeat UV0 and original vertex tints; GLB PBR fallback remains self-contained. No per-model texture duplication.
limitations: Lower facade floor heights and exact glazing subdivisions are fitted to museum exterior photography. The measured upper structure is reconstructed with simplified capitals and scroll brackets.
Roof ribs and 18 circular roof lights per side follow the contemporary engineering account; irregular restoration patches and individual iron fittings are simplified.

The nineteenth-century plate supplies structural dimensions but the present star and modern glazing follow museum photographs. Tiny carved figures and allegorical pediment sculpture are represented only by their architectural surrounds.

Current medium-fi browser models deliberately aggregate distant colonnades and rails, omit subpixel roof fasteners and joints, and use a full-height point proxy for the small terminal star at skyline/district. The true star and roof-light pattern return in street/closeup. Nominal ground contact is host supplied; no surveyed sloping street grade or physical-device performance claim.
reviewStatus: medium-fi; current hash-bound visual acceptance recorded in qa.json

appearance.identity: Asymmetric portico/rear wings, lower classical colonnade and semicircular clerestory, convex pavilion cupola with parallel ribs and circular roof lights, double-order tempietto, circular galleries, octagonal spire and current star.
appearance.master: Keep the detailed source and runtime masters byte-identical. Browser derivatives use source-local component sampling rather than whole-mesh reduction.
appearance.browser: Skyline retains full massing, portico/rear-wing asymmetry, main cupola profile and stepped upper silhouette at full167.5m height. District restores recessed facade/clerestory and a sparse colonnade while aggregating thin upper rails/columns. Street restores full lower column rhythm, ribs and roof lights; closeup adds profile details, more samples, square/circular rails and ribs with side faces. Tiny individual roof fasteners and subpixel joints are omitted.
appearance.scope: Full static exterior with declared photographic reconstruction of minor details. Retained exact-QID center and entrance/rear-wing direction; host supplies nominal base grade. Museum interiors, independent neighbouring buildings and precise sloping street edge are excluded.
